readerCopy.body: Your established track record can open a door that raw potential simply cannot. When the Sun sextiles the North Node, recognition you already earned can support something newer through a recommendation, introduction, invitation, or first chance to lead in unfamiliar territory. Do not mistake a reward for past behavior as an obligation to keep repeating it. Leverage your established credibility to secure the access and capital you need to fund your next evolution.
